text: This solution, ASEAN+3 Climate Disaster Risk Financing Collaboration (SEADRIF) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in South Korea between ASEAN Secretariat, ASEAN+3 member authorities, SEADRIF Insurance Company, World Bank, AMRO, ADB Institute, Hong Kong Monetary Authority, and Global Asia Insurance Partnership. The program was implemented in 2023 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
